scope: public coefficients and six physical observations plus replay; no package full A/b or private weak reactions
metadata_policy: Only personal home prefixes in build diagnostics are projected; every original digest is retained. Scientific inputs, artifacts, receipts and comparator values are copied unchanged. Original build logs remain immutable at the recorded home-backed paths. Relocated package README bytes use a .txt suffix so their original relative links are not reinterpreted as archive documentation.
